case_name: Smt. Dhanalakshmi M vs Venkatesh V.K

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Dhanalakshmi M, wife and mother of minors

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks transfer of two cases: G & WC.No.4/2023 filed under Section 10 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 and M.C.No.273/2022 filed under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: In a petition filed under Section 24 of CPC for transfer of proceedings, the Court shall have to take note of the inconvenience or hardship that would be caused to the wife along with social and financial status of the parties.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and on perusal of the Civil Petition papers, I am of the view that petitioner/wife would be entitled for prayer as sought in both the Civil Petitions.

legal_principles.principle: The Court shall consider the social and financial status of the parties in a petition filed under Section 24 of CPC for transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: the Court shall have to take note of the inconvenience or hardship that would be caused to the wife along with social and financial status of the parties.

outcome.final_order: The court granted the prayer to transfer both cases from the trial court to the VI Additional Principal Family Court at Bengaluru.
